name: SnagOtter
author: Aahil Riyaz Beekay
summary: SnagOtter is a free online video and audio downloader for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and X (Twitter). Paste a link, pick the quality, and save the file. No sign-up, no ads, no watermark added, and it works on iPhone, Android and desktop.

faq.q: How do I download a video with SnagOtter?
faq.a: Copy the video's link from the app or website, paste it into SnagOtter and press Fetch. Pick a quality, or keep the suggested best one, then press Download. The file is saved to your device.

faq.q: Is SnagOtter free?
faq.a: Yes. SnagOtter is completely free, with no account, no sign-up, no ads and no download limit beyond a fair-use rate limit.

faq.q: Which sites does SnagOtter support?
faq.a: YouTube (videos, Shorts, playlists and music), Instagram (Reels, video posts and carousels), TikTok, Facebook (public videos and Reels) and X (Twitter) videos and GIFs, plus many other sites supported by the open-source yt-dlp project.

faq.q: How do I save a video to Photos on iPhone?
faq.a: Open SnagOtter in Safari, paste the link and press Download. When the file is ready, tap Save to Photos, then choose Save Video in the share sheet. The video goes straight into the Photos app.

faq.q: Will the video play on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. With Plays everywhere turned on, which is the default, SnagOtter delivers H.264 video with AAC audio in an MP4, the format every phone, TV and editor plays. If a site only offers VP9 or AV1, SnagOtter converts it for you.

faq.q: Can I download only the audio, as MP3?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Audio only to save the original audio track, or convert it to MP3 (320, 192 or 128 kbps), M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV. Title, artist and cover art are added to the file.

faq.q: What is the highest quality I can download?
faq.a: Whatever the site offers. On YouTube that can be 4K or 8K and HDR when you turn off Plays everywhere. With it on, YouTube offers H.264 up to 1080p.

faq.q: Does SnagOtter keep my videos or links?
faq.a: No. Links aren't logged, and downloaded files are deleted from the server within an hour, or a few minutes after you save them. There are no accounts and no tracking.

faq.q: Can I download private videos or Instagram Stories?
faq.a: No. SnagOtter only downloads public content. Private videos, private accounts and Instagram Stories need a login, which the public site doesn't use.

faq.q: Is it legal to download videos?
faq.a: Only download content you own or have the right to use, such as your own uploads, Creative Commons videos or content the creator allows you to save. Respect each site's terms and copyright law.

faq.q: How do I download a YouTube video?
faq.a: Copy the video link (Share, then Copy link), paste it into SnagOtter, press Fetch, pick a quality and press Download.

faq.q: Can I download a whole YouTube playlist?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the playlist link, choose the videos you want and one quality for all of them, and SnagOtter downloads them one after another.

faq.q: How do I convert YouTube to MP3?
faq.a: Paste the link, choose Audio only and pick MP3. SnagOtter saves the audio as MP3 with the title and cover art embedded.

faq.q: Can I download YouTube Shorts?
faq.a: Yes. Shorts links work like any other YouTube video.

faq.q: How do I download an Instagram Reel?
faq.a: In Instagram, tap Share and Copy link on the Reel, paste it into SnagOtter, press Fetch and then Download.

faq.q: How do I save an Instagram Reel to my iPhone camera roll?
faq.a: Open SnagOtter in Safari, paste the Reel link and press Download. When it's ready, tap Save to Photos and choose Save Video.

faq.q: Can I download photos from Instagram?
faq.a: No. SnagOtter saves video and audio. Photo-only posts aren't supported.

faq.q: Can I download Instagram Stories?
faq.a: No. Stories always need an Instagram login, which the public site doesn't use.
